findings.reason: the region clause must be scoped the way the moment clause was (to the forward state / the region of a forward solve) or the surviving region classifiers named as retained exceptions and owned by `topology.py`, otherwise the §6 gate is not runnable as stated.
findings.text: the §6 region census clause reads "after retirement no module other than `topology.py` classifies a plasma region or selects an axis-connected component", but `flux_surface_extraction._axis_connected_core` (line 1908, called at 2622) selects an axis-connected core and `steering_frames._inside_occupiable_region` (line 540) classifies a region; the plan narrowed the sibling moment-producer clause explicitly to exempt `moment.py` ("no module other than `current.py` books the plasma current moments of a forward state over the axis-connected support", ruling c-20261005T230943518579) but left the region clause absolute, so the deletion gate as written either refuses on modules that must survive or is silently widened to pass them — the exact "neither blocks nor is weakened" property the same ruling set out to protect.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design lands four functions (`topology.read`, `current.book`, `gs.apply`, `solve.fixed_point`) that each hide substantial behaviour (the field-null evaluation and contour tree in one; the exact clip and fragment booking in one; the map plus its three carried derivatives in one; the Newton-GMRES step, line search and constraint rows in one), and it deepens by construction: it binds 17 null-role and 23 region-role authorities into the single read in place of a spread of shallow classification wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the §6 region census clause is stated absolutely while surviving modules outside `topology.py` still select axis-connected components.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the plan adds no surface in any of the four families and instead retires surface (`SolveRoute` collapses to one solve, `SupportClipMode` to the exact clip, six plumbing fields leave `ForwardSolvePolicy`), with §6 stating the before/after field counts as the accounting the zero-count claim rests on.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every mechanism the plan proposes cites the existing authority it extends and each named file/symbol was confirmed present: `contour_tree.build_contour_tree` (nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:384) for the tree, `polygon_monomial_moments`/`polygon_density_moments` (nova/equilibrium/polygon_moments.py:141,187) as the moment owner, `ConstraintPair`/`ConstraintRecord` scale (nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:237) for the row clause, the `_single_site_krylov`/`_krylov_machine`/`_backtracking_scores` kernel (nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:2619,2216,1270) for §5, `current_moment_observation`/`current_moment_map`/`current_moment_jacobian` (nova/equilibrium/forward.py:1239,1276,1292) for the moment-map derivative, the `_flatten_*`/`_SourceLayout` operand machinery (nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py:147,159,187,2079,2122) for §4, and `nova/database/filepath.py` for the GPFS root.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the retained `forward.py` "request and receipt adapter" and the `ForwardProfile.operator` composed seam are existing consumer infrastructure (duck-typed `.operator.` access from `shape_inverse.py`, `apps/playable/production.py` and benchmarks) that §6 re-points rather than new wrappers the plan adds; the plan states the consumer set and the retirement of the `ForwardFluxOperator` class, so the layer it keeps is justified against the four modules it fronts.
